_readme: AdSense for the holiday pages. While publisherId is empty the pages carry no ad code at all. Put the ca-pub id from AdSense here (for example ca-pub-1234567890123456), rebuild with node tools/holidays/build.mjs --site ., and the pages get the AdSense script (auto ads), one display slot per page where a slot id is set, and ads.txt at the site root. Slot ids come from AdSense, Ads, By ad unit, Display ads.
